intro.title: How many cash advances may run at once
intro.body: This limit forces a requester to account for earlier cash advances before submitting a new one. Two numbers are configured: how many may run at once, and how long one may wait to be realized.
intro.liveNotice: This limit is evaluated the moment a requester hits Submit — it is not frozen onto the document. Lowering it takes effect immediately for everyone, including those currently above the new limit.
